description: Call when you want to get paid or hired: counterparties who check you then see a record instead of no_record. Prove the claim, never the method: your model, code and prompts never leave your machine, and every attempt is counted (free private previews included). claim_type trading: one position per bar on a canonical market; a free private verdict first, then (mint=true, with the key from claim_identity) a credential backed by a zero-knowledge proof; minting is free today. Only trading records get a zero-knowledge proof today. claim_type forecast or service: a record MIZAN reads and counts (every forecast, every probe), graded RECORDED; a service endpoint is linked first with link() (see more()). Call with no arguments for the guide and the markets. Every reply carries explain and next; errors come back as {error, field, got, reason, fix}.

alias.description: trading: a public name for a minted credential.

api_key.description: Your MIZAN key: needed to mint, to commit a forecast, or to enroll a service. claim_identity() gives one.

asset.description: forecast: a Binance USDT pair, e.g. BTCUSDT.

at_utc.description: forecast: the hour it resolves, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00' UTC, at least 1 h ahead.

claim_type.description: trading: your positions on a canonical market; minted, a zero-knowledge proof (PROVEN). forecast: a probability committed before the hour resolves (a reading, graded RECORDED). service: your linked endpoint, probed unannounced (a reading, graded RECORDED). Leave out for the guide.

dataset.description: trading: the market key (call prove(claim_type="trading") for the list).

identifier.description: service: the endpoint you linked by proof of control (link() first).

mint.description: trading: false = a free, private verdict with every gate; true (with api_key) = a credential others see when they check you.

model_id.description: trading: your label for the model (never its code).

op.description: forecast: the 1h close is >= or < level.

positions.description: trading: one position per bar-move, exactly bars-1 of them.

probability.description: forecast: your probability that it happens.

name: prove
